title: WritingEvaluationFailedPayload
description: Payload emitted when an IELTS Writing evaluation job encounters a terminal or unrecoverable error.

submissionId.description: Unique identifier of the failed writing submission.

errorCode.description: Canonical machine-readable error code (e.g. GEMINI_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILURE, TIMEOUT).

isRetriable.description: Indicates whether the message can be safely re-queued to the retry topic.

failedAt.description: Timestamp when the failure was recorded (ISO-8601 UTC).
